app.previewBanner: Preview with sample data. These aren't your files.
app.offlineBadge: Works offline. Nothing leaves this PC.

overview.title: Overview
overview.subtitle: Choose a drive to see what's using its space.
overview.notReady: No disk inserted, or the drive isn't responding.
overview.networkHint: Network drives can take a while to scan.
overview.freeHeadlinePending: Cleanup suggestions arrive in an upcoming version.
overview.readOnlyNote: Scanning only reads file names and sizes. Nothing is changed, moved or uploaded.
overview.fastScanSoon: Coming in a later version: reads the drive's file table directly for much faster scans.

status.cancelled: Scan stopped. Showing what was found so far.
status.volumeLost: The drive disappeared during the scan. Showing what was found so far.
status.outOfMemory: The scan stopped because the PC ran low on memory. Showing what was found so far.

explore.title: Explore
explore.emptyBody: Scan a drive or folder first. You'll see a map of everything on it, largest first.
explore.partial: Still scanning. Showing what has been found so far.
explore.metricAllocatedHint: Space actually taken on the drive. Cloud-only files take none.
explore.metricLogicalHint: The size shown in File Explorer.
explore.mapLabel: Map of {{path}}. Larger boxes use more space. Largest items: {{largest}}.
explore.mapHint: Click a folder to zoom in. Right-click for options. Backspace goes up.

badges.cloudHint: OneDrive or another cloud service keeps this file online; it takes no space here.
badges.linkHint: Points to another location. It isn't counted, so nothing is counted twice.
badges.unreadableHint: Windows didn't allow {{name}} to look inside this folder.
badges.hardlinkHint: Another name for a file already counted, so it isn't counted again.

types.title: What kind of files
types.hint: Colours in the map match these types.

menu.label: Options for {{name}}
menu.zoomInto: Open this folder in the map

placeholder.cleanupBody: {{name}} will point out things like temporary files and old update downloads, explain each one in plain language and say how sure it is. You review everything; nothing is removed without your approval.
placeholder.largeBody: A list of your biggest files, so you can decide what to keep. These are your files, your call.
placeholder.duplicatesBody: Find identical copies of your files. Files stored only in the cloud are never downloaded to check them.
placeholder.historyBody: A record of every cleanup: what was removed, when, how much space it freed, and how to undo it.

settings.title: Settings
settings.privacyBody: {{name}} works entirely on this PC. It doesn't send scan results, usage data or anything else over the internet.
settings.logs: Log files are kept on this PC in: {{path}}

onboarding.label: Welcome to {{name}}
onboarding.s1Body: {{name}} maps your drive so the biggest folders and files stand out at a glance. Scanning only reads names and sizes.
onboarding.s2Body: When something looks safe to clean, {{name}} explains what it is, what happens if you remove it and how sure it is. Anything it doesn't recognise is left alone.
onboarding.s3Title: Nothing is deleted without your approval
onboarding.s3Body: You review every item first. By default, removed files go to the Recycle Bin so you can change your mind; if something can't go there, you're told before anything happens. Everything stays on this PC.
